known_limitations.survivorship_bias: The whitelist is 12 names that are large and liquid TODAY. Backtesting them over 2014+ inflates returns because their survival and growth is known in advance. Spec 11.3: disclosed, not corrected.
known_limitations.statistical_power: Spec 7.5: at this sample size only a large edge is detectable. A negative verdict means 'no large edge detectable', not 'no edge exists'.
known_limitations.entry_conservatism: Spec 6.1: entry is the T+1 close. The tradeable 09:45-16:00 window on T+1 is forgone because daily bars cannot model a mid-session fill, so returns understate the live system.
